2026-10-30, by Claude, from aide's .loom/event-log.md

The class apps used mock-control from source, so installing it from npm had never been tried. We set out to make the README a setup guide for an Angular app, settle the package's public surface before the first publish, and find out whether it can stay out of production builds.

Notes on this plan, from drafts/ in the working tree. The plan itself stays as written.

— jeff

Decision: @defer stays the default, and file replacement is documented as an option

where (new) projects/mock-control/README.md › mock-control › Setup › Keeping it out of production file page

made by the work, so there is nothing to resolve

Because (measured): in a production build of the class app, the panel, store, handlers, and MSW land only in lazy chunks behind isDevMode(). They're emitted but never loaded. File replacement removes them entirely, but it costs a stub file and angular.json changes, which is a lot to ask of a class app.

Decline: Analog's Vite plugin to keep mocks out of the build
